data.body_html:
Looking for the ultimate Marbella family boat day jet ski combo? The Mangusta 80 delivers 24 metres of deck space, a free jet ski, and all-inclusive service from Puerto Banús. With room for 12 guests, it's the perfect way to spend a day on the Costa del Sol — swimming, cruising, and riding the waves together. No hidden extras, no hassle.

Why the Mangusta 80 is ideal for families

At 24 metres long, the Mangusta 80 offers generous space for 12 guests. The open-plan layout includes a large sundeck, a shaded cockpit, and a spacious saloon. Kids can move around safely, and the crew are experienced with family groups. The boat is stable at anchor and at cruising speed, so seasickness is rarely an issue. Life jackets are available for all ages, including toddlers.

What's included in the jet ski combo

The Marbella family boat day jet ski combo starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This includes the boat, skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%). Drinks — water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava — and light snacks are all provided. The jet ski is included free of charge. You don't need to bring anything except swimwear and sunscreen.

How the jet ski works on the day

The jet ski is towed behind the Mangusta 80 and launched when you reach a calm bay. The skipper will give a safety briefing and supervise use. Adults and children can ride as passengers; experienced drivers can take the handlebars. Typical stops for jet ski fun include the clear waters off Cala del Faro or the quieter coves near Cabopino. You can also explore the coastline at speed while the boat waits nearby.

Sample itinerary for a family day

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board the Mangusta 80
  • 10:30 – Cruise east towards Cabopino, drinks served
  • 11:30 – Anchor at Cala del Faro for swimming and jet ski
  • 13:00 – Light lunch and snacks on board
  • 14:00 – Return cruise past the Golden Mile, drop-off at Puerto Banús

This is a flexible plan. The skipper can adjust based on weather, sea conditions, and your preferences. Longer charters allow visits to Estepona or Sotogrande.

What to bring and what to expect

Bring swimwear, towels, sunscreen, and a hat. The boat has a fridge, icebox, and plenty of shade. The crew speak English and Spanish. Music can be played via Bluetooth. Toilets are on board. The jet ski is fuelled and ready. Expect a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere — no loud parties, just quality time on the water.

Booking and cancellation policy

To book, contact us via WhatsApp. A deposit secures the date. Balance is payable on the day. Cancellations up to 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, we offer a reschedule subject to availability. Bad weather cancellations are fully refundable. We recommend booking at least a week in advance during peak season (June–September).

Other family-friendly boats in our fleet

If the Mangusta 80 isn't available, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). Both offer similar space and comfort. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a budget-friendly option at €749 for 2 hours. Browse all boat rentals in Marbella to compare.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in the Marbella family boat day jet ski combo?

The charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and a free jet ski. Spanish IVA (21%) is also covered. You just bring yourselves and swimwear.

How many guests can the Mangusta 80 take?

The Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants) accommodates up to 12 guests. This includes adults and children. Life jackets are provided for all ages.

How long is the charter and how much does it cost?

The minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719. Longer durations are available on request via WhatsApp. The jet ski is included free of charge for the entire booking.

Where does the boat depart from?

All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's famous marina. You can park nearby or arrive by taxi. The crew will greet you at the dock.

Can we bring our own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring additional food and drinks. The boat has a fridge, icebox, and a dining area. The included drinks and snacks are already provided.

Is the jet ski suitable for children?

Children can ride as passengers on the jet ski with an adult. The skipper will give a safety briefing and provide life jackets. Minimum age for driving varies, but kids can enjoy the ride.

What are the best stops for families?

Popular family stops include Cala del Faro for calm swimming, Cabopino beach with its dunes, and Estepona for a relaxed lunch. The skipper will tailor the route to your preferences.

What happens in bad weather?

The skipper monitors conditions closely. If weather is unsafe, we can reschedule or offer a full refund. The boat is stable and comfortable, but safety comes first.
